description: Every published RYZM Regime Dial reading, newest first: the regime, rate pressure and liquidity flow, the drivers and the highest-tension signals. A record of readings, not forecasts.

drivers: DXY +1.9% in 20 sessions: tighter dollar liquidity.
US 10Y −11 bp in 20 sessions: less rate pressure.
US 2Y +2 bp in 20 sessions: more rate pressure.

note.text: The KOSPI rose 4.34% to close at 4,915.68 on November 27, 2026, as foreign investors bought a net 1.13 trillion won of local shares.
